subject: Offer call & start-date options for Nadia Singh
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nadia Singh — prep for offer call and timing options

Hi Marissa / Monica,

Quick update on Nadia (Sr. Applied ML Engineer): we finished final interviews last week and the panel recommended hire with the standard IC2 package we discussed. Nadia has asked for an offer call this week and flagged a potential start window: "early Aug or late Jul if possible."

Marissa — can you pull together the base comp+equity numbers and draft an initial offer PDF? Monica — Nadia mentioned she'd like to send a couple of small contract redlines back after the call; if you can be on the thread to triage that that would be great.

Proposed next steps:
- Draft offer PDF and share internally (Marissa)
- Schedule a 30-min offer walk-through with Nadia (I can join) 
- Prepare a DocuSign envelope we can send after the call; we'll pre-fill and leave start date as a selectable field for Nadia to pick from the options below.

Start-date options to present (candidate asked for flexibility):
- Target: Mon, 26 Jul 2027
- Alternate: Mon, 2 Aug 2027
- If earlier is necessary, we can explore Mon, 19 Jul but need manager/IT OK.

I'll host a brief sync at 10:30 PT today if you want to run through numbers.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Park
Lead, Technical Recruiting
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700

Sounds good — I have a draft offer compiled (base + sign-on + 4-yr equity schedule) and attached the PDF for internal review: Offer_Nadia_Singh_v1.pdf (internal stub).

Key callouts:
- Base = $185,000 (target comp band 3);
- Sign-on = $25,000 (prorated monthly if start in Aug);
- Equity = 0.25% over 4 years, 1-year cliff.

If Monica can confirm whether candidate redlines will be purely start-date / minor language, we can pre-approve the counters that don't affect comp. If there are legal-level redlines we'll need a quick review from payroll/comp.

Availability for offer call with Nadia:
- Tue, 22 Jun between 1–3pm PT
- Wed, 23 Jun at 9am PT
- Thu, 24 Jun after 2pm PT

Ethan — confirm which slot works and I will update the draft after the sync.

Attachment: Offer_Nadia_Singh_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB, internal draft)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Nadia Singh <nadia.singh@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Candidate redlines and timing

Forwarding Nadia's note below — she sent back a short redline doc (attached) and a few clarifying questions about PTO onboarding and first-week orientation. I captured the redlines as a doc: Nadia_Redlines.docx (attached stub).

Candidate note (verbatim):
"Thanks — I have two small asks: 1) Can the start date be Aug 2? I have a pre-scheduled research trip the week before. 2) Can we clarify the stock vesting commencement? I want calendar-based vesting if possible. Appreciate the walkthrough. —Nadia"

My read: both are reasonable. Start-date Aug 2 aligns with Marissa's alternate. On vesting, legal will likely push for standard plan language (grant date = close) but we can add clarifying language in the offer and flag for legal if she requests calendar-based vesting explicitly.

Attachment: Nadia_Redlines.docx (docx, 18KB, candidate redlines)

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Singh <nadia.singh@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Hi Nadia,

Thanks for the quick note and the redlines. We appreciate the clarity. I want to confirm next steps and give you options for the start date so we can move forward.

Proposal from Redwood:
- We are comfortable with Aug 2, 2027 as the start date you requested.
- We will keep the vesting language consistent with Redwood's equity plan; if you'd like, we can add an explanatory blurb that clarifies how the grant/vesting dates map to the calendar — Monica will follow up with the legal note if you request calendar-basis vesting.

Can we schedule a 30-min offer walk-through this Wednesday, 23 Jun at 9:00am PT? That will give us time to talk through redlines and I can share a DocuSign envelope at the end of the call for you to review electronically.

DocuSign (pre-filled draft) will be created for signature after our call: https://docusign.com/envelopes/ABC123-nadia-singh

If that time doesn't work, please propose two alternatives.

Best,
Ethan

Redwood Inference

2) For first-week onboarding, let's reserve a short role-specific ramp slot on Aug 3–4 with the ML infra team. I can coordinate once HR confirms final date.
